description: A fold taken WHILE the apply is running (ADR-0086). The plan named four instances for stage.alpha; two of them have finished and nothing is in flight, which under the old rule read `measured` and drew the word `created` over a node three quarters of which did not exist. The denominator comes from the plan and is classified by the same four-bucket rule as everything else: the planned instance of the hidden group inflates nothing.
